pages.text: Health 30, Attack 5, Speed 0.27.$(br)Old Second Round civilisation buried its dead with a care and ceremony all its own: they believed that one day the soul would return and the dead would rise again. These Sediment Guards were among them,.$(br)
and risen as undead they still keep most of the craft they had in life. As a dark wizard you married that to your own necromancy, and found a way to call these ancient people up.

You can raise these guards by ritual, or call them quickly with a $(l:supreme/items/sediment_guard_focus)Sediment Guard Focus$().$(br)You can right-click your Sediment Guard Servant with $(item)Rotten Flesh$() to heal it.
